headline: Pentagon Considers Reduced 5,000-Troop Drawdown in Europe
summary: The U.S. Department of Defense is weighing a smaller reduction of roughly 5,000 troops in Europe, down from an initially feared 25,000. Most cuts would target Germany, while NATO's eastern flank may be reinforced.
why: U.S. force troop allocations in Europe underpin NATO's collective defense structure and military spending commitments among European allies.
